description: OneTrust Auto-Blocking on cdn.cookielaw.org/consent/{domain-script-id}/OtAutoBlock.js. The domain script ID rides in the path. otSDKStub.js with data-domain-script is not contracted. Geolocation on geolocation.onetrust.com is not contracted.

params.name: domain_script_id
params.description: It is the OneTrust data domain script ID. OneTrust documents the Auto-Blocking loader as cdn.cookielaw.org/consent/{id}/OtAutoBlock.js.
params.fix_hint: Copy the Auto-Blocking script from OneTrust Scripts so the path is /consent/{domain-script-id}/OtAutoBlock.js.
